_note: Landing pages for the agency site, one per kind of business, built by npm run agency:build into dist/agency/websites-for/<slug>/. Edit the words freely; 'samples' are sample dirs from samples/samples.json.

niches.label: Restaurants & cafés
niches.intro: Hungry people decide in seconds, usually on their phone. Your website should show the food, the menu and the way to book or order before they scroll past.
features: Menu that's easy to read
Dishes, prices and specials laid out for phones, and easy for you to update.
Table bookings and orders
Reserve, call and WhatsApp buttons on every page, plus a form for group bookings and catering.
Photos that make people hungry
Your best dishes and your space, compressed so the site stays fast on mobile data.
Found on Google Maps
Address, opening hours and a map, set up so you appear when people search nearby.
Events and catering
A page for private bookings, parties and catering enquiries.
faq: Can I change the menu myself?
Yes. The menu is a normal WordPress page, and the training video shows you how to change dishes and prices in a few minutes.
Can customers order online?
Most restaurants start with WhatsApp and phone orders, which every package includes. Full online ordering with payments is quoted separately.
niches.tagline: Fresh food, warm welcome, every day

niches.label: Hotels & homestays
niches.intro: Guests compare rooms, views and reviews before they book. A website of your own lets them book directly, without the commission booking sites take.
features: Rooms that sell themselves
Each room with photos, what's included and who it suits.
Direct booking enquiries
Check-availability buttons and a form for dates and guests, straight to your inbox and WhatsApp.
The experience, not just the bed
Meals, walks, tours and pick-ups that make guests choose you.
Built for travellers abroad
Clear English, international phone links and a map that works for first-time visitors.
Found on Google
Set up for searches like homestays near you, with your location and details right.
faq: Can guests pay online?
Packages include booking enquiries by form, phone and WhatsApp. A booking engine with online payments can be added and is quoted separately.
Will it work with Booking.com and Airbnb?
Yes. Your website sits alongside them and brings direct bookings, so you keep the commission.

niches.label: Hospitals & clinics
niches.intro: Patients look for trust and clear information: what you treat, when you're open and how to get an appointment. Your website should answer all three in seconds.
features: Departments and services, clearly
Each department or treatment explained in plain language, with what to expect.
Appointments in one tap
Call, WhatsApp and appointment-request buttons on every page, and the emergency line where it matters.
Doctors and team
Introduce your specialists and nurses to build trust before the first visit.
Directions that work
Address, map, parking and opening hours, so patients arrive without calling to ask.
Calm, accessible design
Readable text, strong contrast and a layout that works for older patients too.
faq: Can patients book appointments online?
Every package includes an appointment-request form plus call and WhatsApp buttons. A live booking calendar can be added and is quoted separately.
Can we list many departments and doctors?
Yes. The Plus package covers up to eight pages, ideal for hospitals with several departments.

niches.label: Schools & colleges
niches.intro: Parents and students compare several schools before they apply. Your website is often their first visit, so it should show your programmes, your results and how to join.
features: Programmes at a glance
Each class, course or programme with who it's for, duration and next steps.
Admissions made easy
Apply, book-a-visit and call buttons, with a form that goes straight to your office.
Life at your school
Photos of classrooms, labs, sports and events that show what makes you different.
Notices and news
An optional blog for results, events and admission dates.
Found by parents nearby
Set up for local searches, with your address, map and contact details right.
faq: Can we publish notices and results?
Yes. Add the optional blog page, and your staff can post notices without any technical help.
Can students apply online?
Every package includes an enquiry and application form. Online fee payment can be added and is quoted separately.

niches.label: Gyms, yoga & salons
niches.plural: gyms, yoga studios, salons and spas
niches.intro: People join a gym or book a salon when they feel welcome before they walk in. Your website should show the space, the people and how to start.
features: Classes and treatments
What you offer, who it's for and how long it takes, laid out for phones.
Free trial and booking
Book-a-trial, book-an-appointment and WhatsApp buttons on every page.
Memberships and prices
Clear plans, so people know what to expect before they visit.
Your coaches and therapists
Introduce the team members people will actually meet.
Found nearby
Set up for local searches, with location, hours and a map.
faq: Can I show a class timetable?
Yes. A timetable can sit on the Services page, and you can update it yourself.
Can members book classes online?
Packages include booking enquiries by form and WhatsApp. A live booking system can be added and is quoted separately.

niches.label: Shops & online stores
niches.intro: Shoppers want to see what you sell and how to get it. A website gives your shop a home on Google and takes orders while you sleep.
features: Products that look their best
Categories and products with clear photos, prices and details.
Order in a message
Order-on-WhatsApp and call buttons that suit how customers in Nepal like to buy.
Delivery and payment info
Delivery areas, cash on delivery and digital wallets explained up front.
Gifts and bulk orders
A page for festival gift boxes and business orders.
Room to grow
Start simple, and add a full cart with eSewa or Khalti payments when you're ready.
faq: Can customers pay online?
Packages include ordering by WhatsApp, phone and form. A full online store with cart and eSewa or Khalti payments is quoted separately.
How many products can I show?
As many as you like. You can add and edit products yourself after launch.
niches.tagline: Delivered to your door across Nepal

niches.label: Clothing brands
niches.intro: Fashion is visual. Your website should feel like your brand, show the collection beautifully and make ordering as easy as sending a message.
features: Lookbook-style collection
Large photos and a layout that feels like your brand, not a template.
Order on WhatsApp
Every product a message away, with size and delivery questions answered.
Your story
Where your fabric comes from and who makes your clothes. That's why people buy.
Made to measure
A page and form for custom orders and fittings.
Built to share
Pages that look great when shared on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.
faq: Which design style suits fashion?
Bold and Minimal are popular with fashion brands, and Elegant suits bridal and occasion wear. We'll show you all eight styles with your photos.
Can I sell online with a cart?
Yes, as an add-on: a full online store with cart and payments is quoted separately.

niches.label: Travel & trekking
niches.intro: Travellers plan months ahead and compare many agencies. A clear, trustworthy website with honest itineraries is how you win the enquiry.
features: Treks and tours in detail
Itineraries, difficulty, best season and what's included, for every trip.
Enquiries from abroad
Forms and WhatsApp that work for international travellers in any time zone.
Trust signals
Licences, guides, safety and real reviews, front and centre.
Fast on any connection
Compressed images so the site loads quickly, even on slow hotel Wi-Fi.
Found on Google worldwide
Set up for searches like Everest Base Camp trek and Annapurna Circuit.
faq: Can we add many treks?
Yes. The Plus package covers up to eight pages, and more treks can be added as extra pages.
Can travellers pay a deposit online?
Enquiries by form and WhatsApp are included. Online deposits can be added and are quoted separately.

niches.label: Law firms & consultants
niches.plural: law firms, consultants and professional services
niches.intro: Clients choose advisers they trust. Your website should explain what you do in plain language and make the first consultation easy to book.
features: Practice areas, clearly
Each service explained without jargon, so clients know you can help.
Consultations in one step
Book-a-consultation form, call and WhatsApp on every page.
Credibility
Your team, experience and approach presented with quiet confidence.
For clients abroad
Video-call consultations and contact options for Nepalis overseas.
Professional, calm design
Minimal and Elegant styles that suit serious work.
faq: Is client information kept private?
Contact form messages go straight to your inbox and a private list in wp-admin. Nothing is shared with anyone else.
Can we publish articles?
Yes. The optional blog is ideal for legal updates and guides that also help you rank on Google.
niches.tagline: Clear advice, fees agreed up front

niches.label: Real estate & architects
niches.plural: real estate agents, architects and interior designers
niches.intro: Property and design are decided with the eyes. Your website should show your projects and listings at their best and turn interest into a visit.
features: Projects and listings
Large, fast-loading photos of homes, plots and finished projects.
Enquiries that qualify
Forms that ask budget, area and timeline, so you call the right people first.
Your process
How buying, selling or a design project works with you, step by step.
For buyers abroad
WhatsApp and video-viewing options for Nepalis overseas.
Found locally
Set up for searches like house for sale near you and architects in your city.
faq: Can I add new listings myself?
Yes. Listings and projects are normal pages or posts you can add and edit after training.
Can visitors filter properties?
A simple listings page is included. Searchable property listings with filters are quoted separately.
niches.tagline: Homes and spaces that fit your life

niches.label: Photographers, weddings & events
niches.plural: photographers, wedding planners and event venues
niches.intro: Couples and families book with their hearts. Your website should feel like your work: beautiful, calm and easy to enquire from.
features: Portfolio that breathes
Large galleries that show your best work without clutter.
Check-a-date enquiries
A short form for date, venue and guests, straight to your inbox and WhatsApp.
Packages and what's included
Clear options so people know where to start.
Elegant by default
The Elegant style was made for weddings and special occasions.
Shareable
Pages that look lovely when shared in family WhatsApp groups and on Instagram.
faq: Can I update my gallery myself?
Yes. Adding photos takes minutes, and the training video shows you how.
Can I show prices?
Yes, or keep them on request. Many photographers show starting prices and quote the rest.
niches.tagline: Moments you will keep for ever

niches.label: Tech & startups
niches.intro: In tech, your website is your first product demo. It should be fast, sharp and clear about what you build and for whom.
features: What you build, clearly
Services and case studies that speak to founders and buyers, not just developers.
Bold, modern design
The Bold and Minimal styles fit software companies and portfolios.
Start-a-project flow
A short brief form that captures scope, timeline and budget.
Speed you can show off
Lean pages with compressed images and no heavy page builder.
Hiring and culture
An optional careers or about page to attract developers.
faq: Can you connect it to our tools?
Forms go to email and wp-admin by default. Connecting a CRM or Slack can be added and is quoted separately.
Can we edit it ourselves later?
Yes. It's standard WordPress, so your team or any developer can extend it.

niches.label: NGOs & non-profits
niches.intro: Donors and partners want to see impact and honesty. Your website should tell your story, show results and make it easy to get involved.
features: Programmes and impact
What you do, where, and the difference it makes, in numbers and photos.
Get involved
Volunteer, donate and partner buttons that lead to clear next steps.
Transparency
Reports, partners and governance, presented clearly.
Stories from the field
An optional blog for updates that keep supporters close.
Built for partners abroad
Clear English and contact options for international donors.
faq: Can we accept donations online?
Donation enquiries and bank details are included. Online donation payments can be added and are quoted separately.
Do you offer non-profit pricing?
Ask us. We're happy to talk about it for registered non-profits.
